note: schema! omit and pick now match a raw identifier field by its unraw name (r#type), so omit removes it and pick keeps it. The schema macros resolve a bare Value under a SeaORM prelude glob to sea_orm::prelude::Value. Derive(Schema) resolves serde default functions of a struct declared inside a fn body from that fn's module, and refuses an item the file does not declare instead of guessing the top level. Stale-entry bookkeeping keys each registration by its identity, so same-named items of different fn bodies keep their own records. Unknown call-site modules judge no name, and size_of / align_of are std names in the adapter check.
